content: Aristotle was an ancient Greek philosopher and scientist, a student of Plato and teacher of Alexander the Great, whose writings covered many subjects including physics, metaphysics, poetry, theater, music, logic, rhetoric, linguistics, politics, government, ethics, biology, and zoology, profoundly shaping Western intellectual history.
